title: Charge cutoffs converge to a completed triangular local flow

completed_flow.phase_space: X_R is the completion of smooth spatial/K-finite initial data in K1387's finite triangular norm Y_R, including Lorenz-compatible Maxwell data and the charge-regularized matter graph terms
completed_flow.spectral_density: P_N converges strongly to the identity in every finite Q-graph norm, so P_N data are dense in X_R
completed_flow.uniform_lifespan: For data bounded in X_(R+1), K1389 gives one N-independent interval T>=log(2)/(C_(R+1)(1+2Y_(R+1)(0))^2) and a uniform X_(R+1) bound
completed_flow.difference_estimate: For two cutoff solutions on that interval, the X_R difference Z_R obeys dZ_R/dt<=C_R(1+Y_(R+1)^N+Y_(R+1)^M)^2 Z_R; the one extra triangular tier pays every tame coefficient difference
completed_flow.cauchy_limit: The cutoff solutions are Cauchy in C([-T,T];X_R) intersect C^1([-T,T];X_(R-1)) whenever the cutoff initial data converge in X_(R+1)
completed_flow.equation_limit: Sobolev algebra, graph closedness of Q and the uniform X_(R+1) bound pass the covariant matter equation and Maxwell current to the limit
completed_flow.local_result: Initial data in X_(R+1), R>=3, therefore determine a completed local strong solution in X_R with the K1389 a priori bound; data in the intersection of all triangular levels give a smooth solution
completed_flow.boundary: The construction spends one approximation tier and is local. It gives neither global large-data propagation nor a source-owned physical state space
